snippet.title: CHRONO PUNK - steam reveal trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5081550/CHRONO_PUNK/


CHRONO PUNK is a Third-Person Action Rogue-lite, Combining high speed movement, intricate combat systems, and endless build potential. Go Alone or Team up. Discover what awaits in the Clockwork and rebel against the Consortium.

Create your Stitch, Choose your role, and enter the Clockwork, a once sprawling metropolis reduced to ruins. "The Consortium" a mega corporation who has manipulated TIME itself, controlling the city and it's citizens. Your goal is to reach the clock-tower overlooking the city, and topple the Consortium's plans. A spectator, named the Director, offers you strange power... Discover your potential.

CHRONO PUNK is still in early development! expect a lot of stuff to improve.

follow our socials: 
https://discord.gg/gGmk4bqKG
https://www.instagram.com/chrono.punk/

Thanks to our contributors!
julien mendras - Background assets 
https://www.artstation.com/julien_mendras
https://www.instagram.com/julien.mendras.art/?hl=nl

song: SHINNAKU - DOWNFALL
